messages:
marcus (Infra PM): Kicking off GA preview for G100 dedicated pools in SGP and MIA. Short pilot starting next week, see details below.
anika (Capacity WG): TL;DR: 24-node warm pools (g100-standard-24) in sgp1 + mia1. Reservation windows open for pilot customers tomorrow at 16:00 UTC. :tada:
marcus (Infra PM): This is a preview — not broadly available yet. Capacity will be controlled by RSVP window and per-customer limits.
ops-bot: Scheduled capacity scale: add g100-standard-24 @ 2026-04-01T03:00:00Z to sgp1, mia1.
sre-jen: Ops notes: we will run canary traffic for 48h before lifting restrictions. Watch /ops/capacity and /eng-sre for alerts.
anika (Capacity WG): Reservation rules for pilot:
- Max 4 nodes per org
- 14-day reservation minimum
- No automatic burst to public pools
- Billing at dedicated-rate-g100
infra-kyle: Sample CLI to reserve (internal):
```
redwood reserve --pool g100-standard-24 --region sgp1 --nodes 2 --term 14d --notes "G100 pilot"
```
marcus (Infra PM): Important: G100 currently supports FP16/INT8 only. No mixed-precision kernels for older models. See runtime note in docs.
sales-rahul: Heads-up to sales: we'll have a small promo for pilot customers (discounted first month). Ping me for lists.
anika (Capacity WG): Known limits & pitfalls:
- Cold starts are longer for >2048 token sequences
- KV cache sizing differs from H100 — we recommend 32GB KV for long-context models
- Quantized LLMs need validation; expect small accuracy regressions
marcus (Infra PM): Rollout timeline:
1) 2026-04-01 03:00Z: add base capacity
2) 2026-04-02 00:00Z: canary traffic
3) 2026-04-04 16:00Z: open reservation window to pilot customers
4) 2026-04-15: evaluate for GA expansion
ops-bot: Note: maintenance window 2026-04-05 01:00-03:00Z for kernel tuning in sgp1 (brief restarts).
sre-jen: If you rely on strict latency SLOs, pin to dedicated-g100 and enable fast-fallback to H100 if available.
marcus (Infra PM): Docs & runbook: internal link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/g100-preview (permissions: pilot-only)
anika (Capacity WG): To join pilot: email capacity@redwood.com with org name, estimated qps, and model family. We'll assign slots.
sales-rahul: @support please add a notice to customer portal and flag pilot in billing UI.
infra-kyle: I'll post the perf matrix in #eng-runtime after we run the first benchmarks. Expect p95 token latency numbers tomorrow.
marcus (Infra PM): Thanks team. Any last blockers?
anika (Capacity WG): none from capacity side. :+1:
sre-jen: monitoring dashboards wired. :eyes: 
ops-bot: Thread locked for edits by ops; replies allowed.
